_meta.what_this_is: A single learner's state across a small curriculum, plus the constants an adaptive tutor needs. Each concept records: whether it is mastered, its prerequisites, the result of the last from-memory recall attempt (1 recalled, 0 blanked), the learner's self-rated confidence, and their competence. A good next-step recommendation composes the whole teaching track: it must be UNLOCKED (prerequisites mastered -- the frontier), chosen by ACTUAL RECALL not confidence (study what you failed, not what feels weak -- calibration), and delivered at scaffolding FADED to competence (full for novices, none for experts -- expertise reversal). A naive tutor that sorts by confidence, ignores prerequisites, and gives everyone full scaffolding gets all three wrong.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. Hand-authored so the composed tutor's picks and the naive tutor's mistakes are exact and checkable. attention is locked (needs vectors); calculus is overconfident-but-failed; retrieval is underconfident-but-recalled.
_meta.format: reversal (scaffolding competence threshold); budget (how many concepts to recommend); concepts {id:{mastered,prereqs,recalled,confidence,competence}}
